label: Adapted Foucauldian biopower and dispositif into the "raciality apparatus"
description: In her landmark 2005 philosophical dissertation, Sueli Carneiro reworked Foucault's dispositif and biopolitics to show how Brazilian raciality distributes death and commits "epistemicide" against Black knowledge.
dialecticalTension: Corrects Foucault's omission of colonial anti-Blackness in theories of biopower.
historicalContext: University of São Paulo dissertation (2005) & Geledés Black Women's Institute.
